nav.drawerDescription: Links to your notes, labels, archive and trash.

confirmDelete.title: Remove this attachment?
confirmDelete.description: It will be removed from this note. This cannot be undone once you close the note.

errors.unsupported: Audio recording is not supported in this browser
errors.in-use: The microphone is being used by another app

editor.placeholder: Write something, or press '/' for commands…

attachment.notOnServer: Not on the server yet. Try again in a moment.
attachment.downloadFailed: Could not download. Check your connection.

errors.unsupported-type: That file type is not supported here
errors.too-large: The attachment is too large (max {{max}} MB)

density.label: Density
density.description: Compact fits more notes on the screen and sets text a little smaller.

reducedMotion.label: Motion
reducedMotion.description: Reduced turns animation off; Full keeps it on.

colorBlind.label: Colour-blind palette
colorBlind.description: Re-tints note and label colours so the nine stay distinguishable. Works with either theme.

sinkCheckedItems.label: Sink checked items
sinkCheckedItems.description: Checked items are shown at the bottom of their list. The order you typed is never changed.

export.label: Export a backup
export.description: Downloads a .zip with every note, label and attachment.

import.label: Restore from a backup
import.description: Replaces everything currently stored. You can save a backup of it first.

confirmImport.title: Replace all your data?
confirmImport.description: This backup holds {{notes}} notes, {{tags}} labels and {{attachments}} attachments. Everything stored now is deleted and replaced.
confirmImport.backupFirst: Save a backup of my current data first

error.invalid-zip: That file is not a readable backup archive.
error.missing-manifest: That archive is missing its backup manifest.
error.invalid-manifest: That backup is damaged and cannot be read.
error.unsupported-version: That backup was made by a newer version of the app.
error.missing-attachment: That backup is incomplete - some attachment files are missing.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

toolbar.title: Editor toolbar
toolbar.description: Choose which buttons the editor shows, in what order, and which of them share a menu.
toolbar.fold: A phone shows about {{slots}} buttons before this line

width.hint: Narrow and wide are separate layouts. You get the narrow one on a narrow window, and on any touchscreen - a phone stays narrow held sideways.

family.collapse: Put the {{name}} group in one menu

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: These work while a note is open, whichever buttons your toolbar shows.

docs.label: Documentation
docs.description: How it works, and how to run your own server.

quickCapture.title: Quick capture
quickCapture.description: The ways the ＋ button offers to start a note.
quickCapture.lastOne: The last start on the dial - on a phone this is the only way to make a note.

alignment.label: Note button side
alignment.description: Which side of the screen the ＋ button sits on, for the thumb that has to reach it.

install.title: App
install.label: Install YourNotes
install.description: Add YourNotes to your device for quick access in its own window.

update.available: A new version of YourNotes is available.

active.title: No notes yet
active.subtitle: Your notes will show up here. Use the ＋ button to write your first one.
active.subtitleWide: Your notes will show up here. Write your first one in the bar above.

archived.title: Nothing archived
archived.subtitle: Notes you archive are kept here, out of the way but not deleted.

trashed.title: Trash is empty
trashed.subtitle: Notes you delete land here first, so you can still change your mind.

tag.title: No notes with this label
tag.subtitle: Open a note and add this label to see it here.

filtered.title: No matches
filtered.subtitle: Try a different search, or clear the label filters.

confirmEmptyTrash.title: Empty the trash?
confirmEmptyTrash.description: Every note in the trash is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

notes.trashNotice: Notes in the trash are deleted after {{days}} days.

reminders.oneWay: Your calendar keeps its own copy and does the reminding. Clearing or changing this here does not remove it there.

confirmMerge.title: Merge labels?
confirmMerge.description: Notes labelled "{{source}}" will be labelled "{{target}}" instead, and "{{source}}" is deleted.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this label?
confirmDelete.description: It is removed from every note that carries it. The notes themselves stay.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.description: The app hit an unexpected error. Your notes are safe on this device - reloading should get you back.

dnd.instructions: Press Space to pick this up, the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, and Escape to cancel.
dnd.lifted: {{name}} picked up. It is at position {{position}}.

toolbar.title: Your toolbar
toolbar.body: Choose which buttons the editor's toolbar carries, and in what order. Phone and desktop each keep their own arrangement.

quickCapture.title: Your quick starts
quickCapture.body: Reorder the ways in so the one you reach for most comes first, and put the ＋ under whichever thumb you use.

sync.title: Where your notes live
sync.body: Every note is saved on this device first, so the app works offline. Sign in to your own server to keep your devices in step, and export a zip whenever you want a copy.

deviceName.label: Device name
deviceName.hint: How this Device appears in your Devices list.

errors.wrongCredentials: That username or password is not right.
errors.linkUsed: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach your server. Check that this Device can reach it, then try again.

section.title: Account
section.signedOutDescription: Sync this Device's Notes with your YourNotes server.
section.setupGuide: How to set up a server
section.signInDescription: Use the username and password you chose for your account.
section.eraseTitle: Sign out and erase this Device?
section.eraseDescription: Your Notes are on your server and come back when you sign in again. This Device keeps none of them.
section.blockedTitle: Some changes are not on your server yet
section.blockedDescription_one: {{count}} change on this Device has not reached your server. Signing out erases this Device, so sync first or save a backup.
section.blockedDescription_other: {{count}} changes on this Device have not reached your server. Signing out erases this Device, so sync first or save a backup.

devices.title: Devices
devices.removeDescription: It is signed out and nothing else changes.
devices.addDescription: Shows a Pairing Link to scan with the new Device's camera.

members.title: Members
members.inviteDescription: Someone in your household gets their own account. Neither of you sees the other's Notes.
members.resetDescription: Their Devices stay signed in. Give them the new password yourself.

qr.deviceDescription: Scan it with the new Device's camera. It signs in to your account without typing a password.
qr.inviteDescription: The other person scans it on their own phone and chooses their own username and password.
qr.expires: The link works once and for ten minutes.
qr.orOpen: Or open this link on the other Device:
qr.failed: Could not make a link. Try again.

pair.missingCode: This link is incomplete. Scan the QR code again.
pair.ownerDescription: Choose a username and a password. Write the password down somewhere safe: when no signed-in Device is left to show a link, it is the way back in.
pair.deviceDescription: This Device signs in to your account without a password.
pair.inviteDescription: You were invited. Choose your own username and password. Your Notes are your own: nobody else on this server sees them.

sync.keptNewer: Kept the newer version from your server.
sync.title: Storage and sync

storage.label: Stored on this Device
storage.persisted: The browser keeps it even when space runs low.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may clear it when space runs low. Keep a backup.

sync.label: Sync
sync.offline: Offline. Changes wait on this Device.
sync.error: Could not sync. It will try again.
sync.signedOut: This Device is no longer signed in. Sign in again to sync; your changes wait here.

keepEverything.label: Keep everything on this device
keepEverything.description: Download every attachment after each sync, not just previews. Uses more storage.

share.title: Share this Note
share.description: Anyone who can reach this server can open it, signed in or not.
share.notSynced: This Note has not reached your server yet. Try again in a moment.

page.failed: Could not open this Note. Try again later.
